notes: Helper has_direction_control in forms.py over DIRECTION_CONTROLS from rounds/direction.py.

M1.old: return any(ord(char) in DIRECTION_CONTROLS for char in text)

M2.old: return any(ord(char) in DIRECTION_CONTROLS for char in text)
M2.new: return any(ord(char) in DIRECTION_CONTROLS and ord(char) != 0x2069 for char in text)

M3.old: return any(ord(char) in DIRECTION_CONTROLS for char in text)
M3.new: return any(ord(char) in DIRECTION_CONTROLS and ord(char) != 0x202B for char in text)

M4.old: return any(ord(char) in DIRECTION_CONTROLS for char in text)
M4.new: return any(ord(char) in DIRECTION_CONTROLS or ord(char) == 0x200E for char in text)
